sections.text: Hallo, ist ok, für alle zur Info: Hello, that's OK. For everyone's information: Wir werden nur lockere Übungen machen und ein paar Standards, keine großartigen anstrengenden Dinge. We will only do light exercises and a few set pieces, nothing very strenuous. Gruß Regards

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Standards in football are set pieces: free kicks, corners, throw-ins. locker here means light, relaxed. keine großartigen ... Dinge is colloquial for "nothing big". für alle zur Info tells you the coach answers one parent but writes for the whole group.
